purpose: Teach: 本稿/索引/貯蔵/税源/不服/優待/競売/課金

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、本稿の引用文献を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — check the citations in this draft.
lines.style: Calm, direct instruction. Light emphasis on the task itself, not the person. Measured pace. The tone of someone who trusts competence and is simply naming what needs doing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文末尾に索引を加えました
lines.en: Yes. I've added an index at the end of the paper.
lines.style: Quick, respectful acknowledgment. Slight upward lilt on 「Yes」to show attentiveness. Gentle pride in the completed task — he's thought ahead. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究データを安全に貯蔵しろ
lines.en: Ren — store the research data securely.
lines.style: Even more measured than the first instruction. Emphasizes 「securely」with quiet weight. Not commanding, but clear about importance. The tone of experience talking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の税源についても学んでおります
lines.en: Yes. I'm also studying the tax implications of research funding.
lines.style: Soft earnestness. He's showing initiative — slightly longer breath between clauses. Not defensive, but quietly proud that he's thought beyond the immediate ask. Almost apologetic in his thoroughness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、査読の不服にも冷静に対応しろ
lines.en: Ren — respond calmly even when peer review feedback stings.
lines.style: Slightly warmer than the previous instructions. Not a rebuke — more a piece of earned wisdom. Slow pace. The voice of someone who's been hurt by criticism and learned something from it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の学生優待制度を活用しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm using the conference's student support programs.
lines.style: Eager, slightly quicker rhythm. He understands the advice and is already implementing it. Small breath of relief — he has resources. Still respectful but with quieter confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、古書競売で資料を探してみろ
lines.en: Ren — try searching for materials at antiquarian book auctions.
lines.style: A suggestion, not a command — gentler opening attack. Conversational, almost conspiratorial. Like he's sharing an insider tip. Warm, inviting him into a hunting strategy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データベース課金料を予算に組みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll incorporate database subscription fees into the budget.
lines.style: Clear, responsible close. He's understood and is already planning the logistics. Slight finality in the tone — this round of direction is landing. Respectful but grounded.
